answer: What keeps the farms out this epoch is Tincture brewer ointment pot seal kept in the apothecary shop, and the lock on it is each ointment pot is a measured herb yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must. The farm pays 108 POA for the first alias, 108 POA for the second, and so on until the 504rd, when the total stands at 54432 POA. The wander is earned slowly, the copper is earned dearly, and the nadir is earned only by waiting — and the farm wants none of it. The epoch rewards patience, and patience is the one thing a farm cannot print.
